description: Live snapshot for a Solana token (SPL or pump.fun): USD price (Jupiter), 24h volume + primary DEX (Dexscreener), pump.fun metadata (name/symbol/image/socials/mcap), and top-holder distribution from Solana RPC. Optional Helius DAS supply when HELIUS_API_KEY is configured. Free — no signer.

token.description: Base58 Solana mint address. Pass "three" or omit to use the $three reference mint (THREE_MINT env).

name: pump_snapshot
title: Live pump.fun / Solana token snapshot
